tret.definition:
3d pers. sing. pres. of Tread, for treadeth.
n. An allowance to purchasers, for waste or refuse matter, of
   four pounds on every 104 pounds of suttle weight, or weight after the
   tare deducted.
tret.translation:
n. 添头, 补足斤量
[法] 添头
